note: Frozen signed records, ledger steps with their results, ledger outcomes, snapshots, replay rows and owner statements produced by the code at generatedFrom, the last that reserved new split requests under reploid.settlement-replay/v2. Simulated identities on one machine. Signed records and route identities are stored once per set (records, routes) and referred to as {"$record": n} and {"$route": n}. tests/unit/settlement-v2-rules.test.js plants each frozen reservation in a fresh ledger, repeats the steps with the current code and expects the same results.
